title: Apache Drill demo
description: Exercises the Apache Drill data source against Drill's bundled sample data (cp.employee.json, cp.department.json).

list.label: Gender

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM cp.`employee.json` ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM cp.`employee.json` ORDER BY 1

list.name: dept
list.label: Department

query.rawSql: SELECT department_id AS __value, department_description AS __text FROM cp.`department.json` ORDER BY department_id

list.definition: SELECT department_id AS __value, department_description AS __text FROM cp.`department.json`

target.rawSql: SELECT CAST(hire_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS `time`, full_name AS text, position_title AS tags FROM cp.`employee.json` WHERE management_role = 'Senior Management' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(hire_date AS TIMESTAMP))

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(CAST(hire_date AS TIMESTAMP), 90d), gender, COUNT(*) AS hires
FROM cp.`employee.json`
WHERE $__timeFilter(CAST(hire_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AND gender IN ($gender)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT employee_id, full_name, gender, position_title, salary, CAST(hire_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS hire_date
FROM cp.`employee.json`
WHERE gender IN ($gender) AND department_id = $dept
ORDER BY employee_id
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS employees FROM cp.`employee.json` WHERE gender IN ($gender) GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender
